sources.title: German Data Centre Energy Efficiency Register: public annual returns for 2025
sources.source_family: German Data Centre Energy Efficiency Register
sources.attribution: Reporting facility operators via the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE), RZReg.
sources.license: Original register and workbook subject to source terms. Selected factual readings with attribution.
sources.summary: The 2025 German register gives separate annual energy consumption, PUE and WUE figures for 27 named reporting units at the FRA2, NBG1 and FSN1 parks.

extraction.record_scope: Each filing applies only to its named reporting unit. The park identifies the parent property. The source supplies no complete campus figure from these individual returns.

definitions.total_consumption_kwh: Reported calendar-year total energy consumption, workbook column M.
definitions.annual_energy_mwh: Total consumption in kWh divided by 1,000.
definitions.pue_ratio: Annual total data-centre energy divided by IT-equipment energy (column O).
definitions.wue_l_per_kwh_it: Annual water input in m³ divided by IT-equipment energy in MWh, equivalently L/kWh (column R).

sources.date_semantics: The annual directory publishes the latest reporting year. The register’s statistics select 2025 and show that the reported period ends in 2025. Section 3 of the ministry guide defines the last full calendar year, so these figures are dated 31 December 2025.
